name: Linux runtime (Arch Linux ARM)
note: Arch Linux ARM (rolling) aarch64 runtime for DroidHost, built by tools/arch in linuszz/DroidHost (6bfee8b4992e6308e58de12100faf23a414aeafa) from the signature-checked Arch Linux ARM tarball. Its KDE Plasma desktop pack is desktop-kde.tar.zst in release desktop-kde-r5 of the same repository, named inside the runtime at usr/share/droiddeck/desktop-pack.json.
